findings.reason: The ELF values are digitized group means from terminal samples. The note says no SD or individual IDs were recovered, so animal-level trajectories and variability cannot be established from this item.
findings.needed_material: Original per-time sample counts, variability and individual records if animal-level analysis is proposed; otherwise retain the group-mean designation and digitization provenance.

findings.reason: The item names ELF and IT administration, but does not state ELF total or unbound concentration basis or formulation. Its plasma fu is explicitly not to be applied to ELF.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed ELF concentration-basis and formulation definitions before any conversion, comparison or physiological bridge.

findings.reason: The notes identify nominal times, a single dose, terminal samples and digitized means, but do not recover individual IDs or numeric SD. The stated caption and methods counts do not identify which animals contributed to each plotted mean.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the sampling and summary definitions and assess whether these group-level inputs suffice for the proposed pulmonary component during animal PK design.

findings.reason: The note reports a same-study plasma binding value, while the assigned requirements assess source preparation and animal PK inputs. A binding-specific requirement was not assigned to this item.
